To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the flow in the refrigerator is laminar with a recirculation zone in the bottom of the enclosure, that the thickness of the boundary layers is about 1 cm and that the velocity of the airflow is of the same order of magnitude as that of the airflow in a room.
the PIV measurements and the CFD simulations of flow field in a model of domestic refrigerator show good agreement.
the numerical simulations using the commercial software Fluent can be used to describe the flow field and to predict the heat transfer between the different walls.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the flow field inside a domestic refrigerator model, in the case of a cold wall maintained at a negative temperature and in the case of an evaporator.
the development of an efficient and accurate numerical simulation of the flow and the heat transfer in the refrigerator model.
the development of a numerical model to describe the airflow and the heat transfer in the evaporator of a domestic refrigerator model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PIV method has been proven to be a reliable and accurate technique to measure the flow field in this type of cavity.
the PIV method is a powerful tool for the study of the flow field inside refrigerators.
the numerical simulations are in good agreement with the PIV experimental results, which is a good validation of the numerical code used in this study.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the numerical results can provide a good prediction of the flow field and temperature distribution in a domestic refrigerator, and the 3D simulations are more accurate than the 2D ones.
the 3D CFD simulation can be used as a tool for predicting the flow field and the heat transfer in the refrigerator model.
the 3D simulation of the flow field and temperature distribution in the cavity is in good agreement with the PIV measurements.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3D simulations of the natural convection in the refrigerated cabinet model are able to reproduce with accuracy the main flow characteristics observed in the experimental study.
the 3D simulation is a powerful and reliable tool to predict the flow field inside a refrigerator.
the numerical simulation of the flow in the refrigerator cavity is quite reliable and can be used for design and optimization of the refrigerators.
